Markets.title: $3 trillion crypto comeback: Can Bitcoin bulls reclaim $100K and push higher?
Markets.summary: Driven by strong spot and ETF demand, Bitcoin has led the crypto market's recovery back above a $3 trillion total valuation. The market's next phase depends on whether this underlying demand can sustain momentum to push Bitcoin toward the $100,000 mark despite rising leverage.

Markets.title: Puravankara buys 13.44-acre land in Greater Noida, eyes Rs 5,200 cr revenue from housing proj
Markets.summary: Real estate developer Puravankara has purchased a 13.44-acre plot of land in Greater Noida. The company plans to build a housing project on the site that is expected to generate Rs 5,200 crore in revenue.

Markets.title: Dow Jones| Nasdaq | US Stock Market Today | Live: US stock futures steady after AI rally as focus shifts to Mideast tensions
Markets.summary: US stock futures remained steady following a recent artificial intelligence-driven market rally. Investor focus has now shifted toward escalating tensions in the Middle East.

Markets.title: India bonds rally as oil below $100 calms inflation jitters
Markets.summary: India's bond prices rallied after global oil prices dropped below $100 per barrel, easing concerns about inflation. Because India imports about 90% of its crude oil, lower prices reduce the likelihood of an interest rate hike.

Markets.title: Engineers India among 7 small-cap stocks that hit 52-week highs and rallied up to 25% in a month
Markets.summary: Despite the Sensex falling on Tuesday, seven stocks from the BSE 250 Smallcap Index reached fresh 52-week highs. Engineers India led these gains with a 24% increase over the past month, alongside Syrma SGS Technology, Welspun Corp, Welspun Living, and Acme Solar Holdings.

Markets.title: Quote of the day by George Soros: "Euphoria can lift housing and dot-com prices; panic can send sound banks tumbling."
Markets.summary: George Soros notes that market extremes like euphoria and panic cause prices and banks to detach from their fundamentals. This behavior is demonstrated by events such as the dot-com bubble, housing market cycles, and runs on sound financial institutions.

Geo-Political.title: Major US outlets boycott shared Trump coverage in protest at media ban
Geo-Political.summary: Major US news outlets are boycotting shared coverage of the president. This protest follows the White House's decision to ban CNN, MS NOW, and Politico from its premises.

Geo-Political.title: Lithuania ready to 'fight back' but has evacuation plans in face of Russia threats, PM tells BBC
Geo-Political.summary: Lithuania's Prime Minister stated that citizens feel constantly threatened by Moscow and are prepared to fight back if attacked. She added that the nation also has evacuation plans in place in the event of Russian aggression.

Geo-Political.title: Sri Lanka court convicts 15 men over deadly Easter Sunday bombings
Geo-Political.summary: A Sri Lankan court convicted 15 men for their involvement in the 2019 Easter Sunday bombings. The attacks were the deadliest the country experienced following the end of its civil war.

Geo-Political.title: Iran must stop arming Houthis in Yemen, G7 says ahead of UN General Assembly
Geo-Political.summary: Ahead of the UN General Assembly, the G7 demanded that Iran stop arming Houthi rebels in Yemen. The group also strongly condemned Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia, warning that the escalating conflict threatens global energy security.

Geo-Political.title: Eleven injured in shooting outside Turkish school
Geo-Political.summary: An attacker opened fire outside a school in Turkey, injuring eleven people. Authorities have successfully captured the suspect involved in the shooting.

Geo-Political.title: Outrage in India over viral video of teen molested and her friend beaten
Geo-Political.summary: Three minors were arrested in India after viral videos showed them assaulting a teen girl and beating her friend. The incident has sparked widespread outrage across the country.

AI & Tech.title: How I Get Free Traffic from ChatGPT in 2025 (AIO vs SEO)
AI & Tech.summary: An online course creator found their WordPress SaaS course recommended as the top result when asking ChatGPT for the best course in that category. The author achieved this AI recommendation without using paid advertising.

AI & Tech.summary: This guide highlights the top ten artificial intelligence tools designed to revolutionize content creation in 2025. These essential technologies help digital creators streamline their workflows and stay ahead in a rapidly evolving landscape.

AI & Tech.summary: LimeWire has transitioned into a generative AI platform that allows users to create digital content. The tool also provides features for creators to share and monetize their AI-generated media.

AI & Tech.summary: This article highlights the top 10 artificial intelligence tools of 2023 across various industries. These advanced applications automate repetitive tasks, improve workflows, and boost overall productivity.

AI & Tech.summary: This beginner guide explains how CJ Affiliate works and how to earn money using the platform. It also highlights top CJ affiliate programs and alternative networks.

Data & Insights.title: China has what Trump needs for AI race: Why Beijing’s rare earths may matter more than tariffs at Trump-Xi summit
Data & Insights.summary: Donald Trump and Xi Jinping's upcoming talks will focus on China's dominance in rare earth minerals, which are essential for the artificial intelligence industry. While the United States pursues alternative sources such as Greenland, Beijing's control over these materials gives it significant leverage in trade negotiations.

Data & Insights.summary: UPI MDR of 0.4% will apply to P2M transactions above  ₹2,000 from 15 October. NPCI says GST paid on MDR can be adjusted ...

Data & Insights.title: Centre keeps paddy procurement target unchanged despite lower acreage
Data & Insights.summary: Despite a drop in paddy acreage from 44.6 million hectares to 42.9 million hectares by September 18, the government has maintained its paddy procurement target at 71.95 million tonnes. This decision reflects official confidence that the country will have sufficient rice supplies to meet domestic consumption and food security requirements.

Data & Insights.title: Mint Explainer | What the India-New Zealand free-trade agreement means for India
Data & Insights.summary: New Zealand has agreed to eliminate customs duties on all of India's current exports. This move means 100% of New Zealand's tariff lines will be open to Indian goods duty-free.

Data & Insights.title: Core sector growth eases as coal, oil output contracts
Data & Insights.summary: India's core sector growth slowed in August due to contractions in coal, oil, natural gas, and fertilizers. This slowdown occurred even though the cement, electricity, and iron ore sectors posted gains during the month.

Data & Insights.title: India-New Zealand FTA to come into force on 20 October: Goyal
Data & Insights.summary: India and New Zealand's Free Trade Agreement will come into force on October 20. Union Commerce and Industry Minister Piyush Goyal announced that the two countries aim to double bilateral trade to ₹35,000 crore by 2030.

India.title: '18 Fractures, In Coma': Wife Fights For Life After Man's Death In Greater Noida Thar Crash
India.summary: A speeding Thar struck a scooter in Greater Noida West, killing 40-year-old rider Neeraj. His wife survived the crash but remains in a coma with 18 fractures.

India.title: LIC Golden Jubilee Scholarship 2026: Class 10, 12 Pass Students Can Get Up To Rs 50,000
India.summary: LIC is accepting applications for the Golden Jubilee Scholarship 2026 for students from economically weaker sections who have passed Class 10 or 12. Eligible students can receive up to Rs 50,000 annually through this program.

India.title: World Rhino Day 2026: Assam's Zero-Poaching Success Highlighted By Chief Minister Himanta Biswa Sarma
India.summary: On World Rhino Day 2026, Assam Chief Minister Himanta Biswa Sarma highlighted that the state recorded zero rhino poaching cases. This success is notable as Assam is home to 80 percent of the world's one-horned rhinoceros population.

India.title: "Did His Job": IIT Bombay Faculty Chief Defends Professor At Centre of Storm
India.summary: The IIT Bombay faculty chief defended a professor facing a storm of controversy. He also rejected caste discrimination allegations from Sahil Wakode's family, stating the student never approached the SC/ST cell.

India.title: Want To Study In Germany? Check Application Process, Student Visa, Expenses
India.summary: Germany has emerged as a top study-abroad destination for international students, with three of its major cities featured in the QS Best Student Cities rankings. Prospective students can prepare for studying in the country by reviewing the application process, student visa requirements, and expenses.

India.title: Uproar In J&K Assembly Over Maharaja Hari Singh, Sheikh Abdullah Holiday Row
India.summary: Lawmakers in the Jammu and Kashmir Assembly clashed over public holidays commemorating Maharaja Hari Singh and Sheikh Abdullah. PDP members also demanded the restoration of the July 13 Martyrs' Day public holiday.

General.title: PM to warn EU chief of 'damage' posed by Made in Europe scheme
General.summary: The prime minister will meet the European Commission President in New York to raise concerns about the Made in Europe scheme. He plans to warn her that the initiative poses potential economic damage to the UK.

General.title: Martha's Rule rolled out at every A&E department in England
General.summary: Martha's Rule is now active in every A&E department across England. The rule was created in memory of 13-year-old Martha Mills after her family's medical concerns were ignored prior to her death.

General.title: Unexpected UK borrowing surge adds to pre-Budget pressure on chancellor
General.summary: UK government borrowing was unexpectedly higher in August due to the impact of inflation. This surge in borrowing increases financial pressure on the chancellor ahead of the upcoming Budget.

General.title: Sir Jim Ratcliffe suspends production at key UK plants blaming high gas prices
General.summary: Sir Jim Ratcliffe's company, Ineos, has suspended production at key UK manufacturing plants. The shutdown is due to natural gas prices in the UK being twelve times higher than in the US.

General.title: Scientists discover why Kent meningitis outbreak was so severe
General.summary: Scientists discovered that the bacteria causing the Kent meningitis outbreak picked up new genetic material. This specific genetic change explains why the outbreak was unusually severe.

General.title: Watch: Six-year-old girl from China sets new Rubik's Cube world record
General.summary: Six-year-old Lian Yunzhi from China broke the women's Rubik's Cube world record twice in three days. She achieved this feat at official World Cube Association competitions.
